nodes.label: 26PR104 · Wong Tim Hi suspended
nodes.summary: The SFC suspended Wong Tim Hi for nine months following regulatory breaches.

nodes.label: Mr Wong Tim Hi
nodes.summary: Former Yuanta licensed representative whose licence was suspended for nine months.

nodes.label: Securities and Futures Commission
nodes.summary: Hong Kong regulator that investigated and suspended Wong.

nodes.label: Yuanta Securities (Hong Kong) Company Limited
nodes.summary: Licensed corporation to which Wong was accredited from 2013 to 2026.

nodes.label: Ching Lee Holdings Limited
nodes.summary: Issuer whose shares were involved in related false-trading proceedings.

nodes.label: Two third parties
nodes.summary: Unnamed parties allowed to operate or act for four client accounts.

nodes.summary: Clients whose account information and instructions were at issue.

nodes.label: Shares of Ching Lee
nodes.summary: Shares involved in the false-trading proceedings described by the release.
